rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Rádio Senado's item of 12 May 2016 (14h16, updated 15h21) reports that on the morning of Thursday 12 May the First Secretary of the Senate, Vicentinho Alves, delivered to Vice-President Michel Temer at the Palácio do Jaburu the notification that he would assume the Presidency on an interim basis, and that shortly before, at the Palácio do Planalto, he had notified Dilma Rousseff of her removal from office for up to 180 days while the Senate judges the process; the session begun at 10:00 on 11 May ended at 6:38 on 12 May.
